status_definitions.DIRECT_TASK_EVIDENCE: PC is listed in >=1 of T1-T5's linked_pcs -- an assessor scores it from captured evidence (photo/video) against rubric.json's anchors.
status_definitions.DECLARATION_OR_ASSESSOR_NOTE: PC belongs to CON/N8001, CON/N8002 or DGT/VSQ/N0101 -- covered only by the worker's self-declaration plus up to 3 short assessor questions, recorded as notes. No task evidence, no 0-3 rubric score. Stated MVP limitation, not an oversight.
status_definitions.NOT_ASSESSED_IN_MVP: PC has no task reference and is not in a declaration-only NOS. Must be an empty set for the pinned CON/Q0602 v4.0 pack -- pack_validate.py's [links] check fails the build otherwise.
